items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I suggested to Dizzy in a bus going up from New York to Boston that he should have Chano come out and his “yanyow” thing.

ctx.x: Okay. And I was wondering, was that what you were talking about?
Yeah, and then after that, it was all mine, after he – Chano – I suggested to Dizzy in a bus going up from New York to Boston that he should have Chano come out and his “yanyow” thing.
